roadmap.title: Normal playthrough with objectives
roadmap.description: Finish all 10 memory sequences on Normal. Earn the five story unlocks, keep Memory Sequence 4 alert-free for Ghost Train while holding the score combo for Combo Master, spare every enemy during the Sequence 7 sniping sections, and complete Sequences 8 and 9 without kills. Start the cumulative counters at the Sequence 1 rooftop and the Sequence 6 Helix Blade spot as they come up.

roadmap.title: Plus Hard no-alert playthrough
roadmap.description: Plus Hard unlocks after the first completion. Replay the whole game without alerting any enemy; kills are allowed as long as every body is hidden and no alert triggers. Use Eagle Vision for enemy sight cones and reload the checkpoint after any mistake. Finishing this run awards A True Assassin.

roadmap.title: Memory Select cleanup
roadmap.description: Replay individual memories through Memory Select for any cumulative counter or conditional unlock still unfinished after the story run: the three 30-rating grinds, 100 headshots, 25 electrocutions, the 3-at-once electrocution, and 25 Helix Blade kills. Checkpoint reloads count toward every cumulative counter.

steps.text: Play Memory Sequence 1 through to its end.
Play Memory Sequence 3 through to its end.
Play Memory Sequence 6 through to its end.
Play Memory Sequence 8 through to its end.

achievements.description: Achieve a Shadow Gold rating 30 times.

guide.context: The game scores each section as you pass its checkpoint. Shadow Gold requires no kills, no takedowns, no alerts, and no bodies found. Checkpoint reloads and Memory Select replays count toward the total.

steps.text: Play Memory Sequence 1 to the rooftop section that follows the tutorial knockout.
Hide in a green roof vent until the patrolling guard looks away, then drop to the red planks and cross the checkpoint for @mechanic{Shadow Gold}.
Reload the checkpoint and repeat the section until you have 30 Shadow Gold ratings.

achievements.description: Achieve a Assassin Gold rating 30 times.

guide.context: Assassin Gold requires at least one kill, no alerts, and no bodies found. Checkpoint reloads count toward the total.

steps.text: Play Memory Sequence 1 to the rooftop section that follows the tutorial knockout.
Shoot the guard before he sees you, then cross to the planks and the checkpoint for @mechanic{Assassin Gold}.
Reload the checkpoint and repeat until you have 30 Assassin Gold ratings.
steps.note: After Helix unlocks in Memory Sequence 6 you can farm there instead: disintegrate the guard beside you with it, reach the checkpoint, then restart the memory.

achievements.description: Achieve a Silencer Gold rating 30 times.

guide.context: Silencer Gold requires at least one non-lethal takedown, no kills, no alerts, and no bodies found. Checkpoint reloads count toward the total.

steps.text: In Memory Sequence 1, reach the tower where planks lead down to a train and take the board on the right.
Knock out both guards, starting with the right one so the sleeping guard stays unaware.
Go down the planks, board the train, and stay ducked while moving to the front.
Climb the planks and hop the railing for @mechanic{Silencer Gold}, then reload the checkpoint and repeat until you have 30 Silencer Gold ratings.

achievements.description: Don't kill any enemies in the Orelov Sniping sections in Memory Sequence 7.
achievements.summary: Incapacitate every enemy in the Memory Sequence 7 sniping sections without killing a single enemy.

guide.context: Shoot from Nikolai's sniping positions on Normal difficulty. A fallen enemy who still glows gold under Eagle Vision was only incapacitated; checkpoint reloads erase any kill that slips through.

steps.text: Play Memory Sequence 7 to Nikolai's first sniping section and turn on @mechanic{Eagle Vision}.
Shoot enemies in the stomach or lower body, never in the head.
Reload the checkpoint at once if any shot kills an enemy.
Do not shoot truck drivers or enemies standing on the ground floor; reload the checkpoint if one dies.
Clear every Nikolai sniping section in Memory Sequence 7 without a kill to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequences 8 and 9 without killing anyone.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequences 8 and 9 without a single kill.

guide.context: Non-lethal knockouts are allowed and do not fail the run; only kills count against the achievement. Either sequence can be replayed through Memory Select.

steps.text: Finish Memory Sequence 8 without killing anyone.
Near the mine, do not pickpocket the guard's @item{magnetic key}; he dies on the mine and fails the achievement.
Destroy the top-right generator before moving on; otherwise the next window's trap kills you.
Wait until the magnetic-key guard looks out of the right window, then slip past him.
Finish Memory Sequence 9 without killing anyone; knock out any guard in your way instead.

guide.context: Headshots count during the scripted sniping sections, and reloading the checkpoint keeps the headshots already banked.

steps.text: Play Memory Sequence 1 to the first sniping section.
Headshot the first four enemies as they appear.
Reload the checkpoint and repeat until 100 headshots are counted.
steps.note: Memory Sequence 7's sniping sections add another 30 or more soldiers on a normal run.

guide.context: Nikolai's winch shocks guards unconscious, and the counter keeps checkpoint reloads.

steps.text: Start Memory Sequence 8 and play through the opening checkpoints to the winch electrocution section.
Electrocute the enemies gathered there, then reload the checkpoint and repeat until 25 are counted.

achievements.description: Electrocute 3 enemies at the same time.

steps.text: In Memory Sequence 8, reach the pool of water where three enemies stand together.
Shock the group with the winch so all three drop together.
If the achievement does not unlock, reload the checkpoint and try the shock again.

achievements.summary: Use the Helix Blade on 25 enemies.

guide.context: The @item{Helix Blade} is Anastasia's kill ability from the end of Memory Sequence 6 and disintegrates the body. Checkpoint reloads count toward the total.

steps.text: Play Memory Sequence 6 to the section after the Helix Blade tutorial, where the game points you at a nearby guard.
Kill that guard with the Helix Blade, then reload the checkpoint.
Repeat the kill and reload until 25 Helix Blade kills are counted.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 4 without alerting the enemies.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 4 without alerting any enemy.

guide.context: An alert triggers when the sign above a guard turns red or your shadow afterimage appears. Memory Sequence 4 forces kills, so stay unseen and hide every body.

steps.text: Clear Memory Sequence 4 while killing only guards who cannot see you.
Hide every body, and drag bodies out of other guards' lines of sight where no hiding spot exists.
Use @item{smoke bombs} indoors, but remember that gas-masked enemies ignore smoke.
Restart the checkpoint if a section raises an alert or a body is found.
Finish Memory Sequence 10, including the closing chase and the tank fight.
steps.note: In the tank fight's three sniping sections, shoot the soldiers firing at you first, then the red parts of the tank.

achievements.description: Complete any Memory Sequence other than Memory Sequence 1 without losing your Score Combo once.
achievements.summary: Finish a Memory Sequence other than Sequence 1 without losing the Score Combo once.

guide.context: The @mechanic{Score Combo} multiplier must survive an entire sequence in one attempt, and Memory Sequence 4 is the safest pick because its forced kills score as Assassin Gold almost everywhere.

steps.text: Play Memory Sequence 4 and keep the Score Combo alive from start to finish.
Reload the checkpoint or restart the sequence as soon as the combo breaks.

achievements.description: Complete Assassin's Creed® Chronicles: Russia in Plus Hard mode without alerting any enemy.
achievements.summary: Finish Assassin's Creed Chronicles: Russia on Plus Hard without alerting any enemy.

guide.context: Plus Hard unlocks after you finish the game once. Enemy vision cones appear only under @mechanic{Eagle Vision}, and being seen briefly is safe as long as no alert triggers. Alarms are only tolerated during the scripted chase sequences and the window-rescue sequence.

steps.text: Play the game on Plus Hard and keep Eagle Vision on to read enemy vision cones.
Kill or knock out blocking guards only when unseen, and hide every body; drag bodies out of sight where no hiding spot exists.
Never take down or kill an enemy who is talking on a communicator.
Knock out a guard before stealing his @item{magnetic key}; an awake guard can walk into a mine later and raise an alert.
Reload the checkpoint after any alert or mistake.
If you are already past the checkpoint, quit to the main menu and restart that memory on Plus Hard.
Finish all ten memory sequences without an alert to unlock the achievement.
